cues.text: Inside most clothes there is a care label with little pictures. Here is what they mean.
A tub means washing. The dots tell how hot the water can be. A hand in the tub means hand wash only.
A triangle means bleach. A triangle with an X means no bleach.
A square means drying. A circle inside the square means it can go in the dryer.
An iron means ironing. One dot is low heat. Three dots is high heat.
A circle means dry clean. The letter inside tells the cleaner which method to use.
Any picture with an X on it means no. Do not wash, no bleach, do not iron, or do not dry clean.
Dry clean means it is a good idea. Dry clean only means it must be dry cleaned.
Labels are not always right. Use what you learned, and when you are not sure, ask a manager.
